dataset: OS OpenMap–Local — ImportantBuilding, SX GeoPackage distribution
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local specification defines ImportantBuilding as a generalised building belonging to a FunctionalSite. The ImportantBuilding feature carries BuildingTheme, classification, distinctiveName and featureCode, and its geometry is explicitly a GM_Surface polygon representing the generalised important building. OS OpenMap–Local is an OS OpenData product available under the Open Government Licence. The selected official no-login SX GeoPackage download endpoint was materially different from the prior FunctionalSite documentation window and was intended to retrieve record-level Exeter-area ImportantBuilding features. The web retrieval channel could not access the parameterised API URL and direct network resolution failed before a response payload was obtained, so zero records were read and no geometry was fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official OS OpenMap–Local ImportantBuilding specification defines geometry as a GM_Surface polygon representing the generalised important building.
field_evidence.record_binding: ImportantBuilding carries BuildingTheme, classification, distinctiveName, featureCode and geometry on the same feature type.
field_evidence.type_use: classification describes the actual function; BuildingTheme describes the functional theme; distinctiveName can identify the building/site.
field_evidence.retrieval: The selected official public no-login SX GeoPackage download endpoint produced no retrievable payload in the available web channel; direct network resolution failed before any record payload was received.
